housing-numbers.notes: Housing target is 'at least' 17,000 homes for 2008-2028. Strategic allocations include Monkton Heathfield (4,500), Priorswood/Nerrols (900), Wellington sites (1,800 total). Broad locations include Comeytrowe/Trull (1,000-2,000) and Staplegrove (500-1,500), using midpoint estimates. Annual requirement varies by phase: 704dpa (2011-16), 904dpa (2016-21), 1076dpa (2021-28).
